messages:
Maya (CS): quick heads-up — onboarding sync failures observed for ~12 trial accounts starting ~09:14 UTC. Errors: 401/403 on webhook handshakes and failed initial index jobs. I’m drafting customer comms but need Eng/SRE confirmation on mitigation and ETA. @diego @liam
incident-bot: automated alert: webhook-auth-failures > threshold; runbook #onboard-failures triggered at 09:16 UTC
Diego (Eng): root cause appears to be a token rotation script that ran against a subset of prod namespaces due to a config mismatch. Rolled back the rotation at 09:28 UTC and re-applied correct env in canary at 09:30 UTC. Handshakes have recovered for 8/12 accounts. Two accounts still failing due to IP whitelist + stale webhook secrets.
Liam (SRE): requeued failed webhook deliveries and kicked off manual retries for the two stuck accounts at 09:35 UTC. Queue is draining; one account shows successful handshake at 09:40 UTC. ETA ~30-45m for full recovery if no other blocking config on customer side.
Nina (CS Manager): thanks — draft outreach idea: split affected set into (A) auto-recovered, (B) manual-assist. For (A) send short status note + ask to verify onboarding. For (B) offer scheduled troubleshooting + temporary credit. Propose 1-month credit for impacted trials and a 30-min live session.
Maya (CS): copying draft outbound for review (short, customer-facing):
```
Hi — we detected an issue that prevented some trial accounts from completing onboarding between 09:14–09:30 UTC. Our team has rolled back the misapplied token rotation and most accounts are back online. If you still see errors, we’ll run a manual retry and can hop on a quick call to resolve it. We’ll follow up with a full RCA within 48 hours. If you’d like immediate help, book a slot: https://cal.example/redwood-cs. Quick feedback form: https://survey.example/rca
Apologies for the disruption — Maya, Customer Success
```
Diego (Eng): fine with that. Add one line linking to status page + incident id. Also note internal root cause: rotation script lacked a production guard; PR #4321 contains the fix.
Liam (SRE): confirm monitoring alert thresholds adjusted to avoid noisy re-alerts. I’ll keep an eye until 10:30 UTC.
Maya (CS): scheduling outbound in 20m to affected accounts: I’ll tag them into two groups and include the 1:1 booking link + short survey. Nina — can you approve the credit offer and scope?
Nina (CS Manager): yes approve. Billing: tag affected tenants for a courtesy trial extension credit. Also please add a short call offer for any renewal-risk customers (we should prioritize those).
Diego (Eng): quick ops note — we’ll create a postmortem doc and link it to the customer follow-up. Root-cause summary to include: missing env check + absent canary guard -> rotation applied broadly, mitigation steps + PR link.
Liam (SRE): created support ticket RN-87432 and attached logs. I’ll update when final account restores confirmed.
Maya (CS): final checklist before outbound: (1) split recipients A/B (I’ll do), (2) include status page + incident id, (3) include booking link + survey, (4) tag billing for credit, (5) commit to RCA within 48h. Anyone object?
Diego (Eng): no objections.
Nina (CS Manager): good to send. Please BCC exec-contacts for any accounts flagged as renewal risk.
Maya (CS): sending now — will paste sent copy here and create follow-up thread for the RCA. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
